question: What are the available intent types for the Callout component and their default icons?
ground_truth: The Callout component has 8 available intent types: info (default icon: InfoCircle), warning (default icon: Bell), success (default icon: CheckCircle), error (default icon: WarningTriangle), note (default icon: Pin), launch (default icon: Rocket), tip (default icon: Star), and check (default icon: Check).

metadata.cited_context: The type of callout. Available options: `info`, `warning`, `success`, `error`, `note`, `launch`, `tip`, `check`... If not specified, uses a default icon based on the intent: - info: InfoCircle - warning: Bell - success: CheckCircle - error: WarningTriangle - note: Pin - launch: Rocket - tip: Star - check: Check
